philosophies: Delicate Boundaries: Use 1px borders, never rigid thick strokes.
Generous Geometry: Pill shapes for interactive controls, large 16-24px radii for structural containers.
Zinc Scale: Use strict monochrome Zinc scales rather than standard gray/slate for a premium modern feel.
Subtle Contrast: Soft backgrounds for layering, avoiding stark contrast jumps unless highlighting primary actions.
Natural Typography: Let the Cairo font breathe naturally without forced capitalization or extreme letter spacing.
ai_ux_principles: Low-noise assistant UI with one clear next step per card.
Visible control and privacy states when session behavior matters.
Graceful failure and inline recovery before escalation.
RTL-first React Native layout and writing direction defaults.
Cursor-card wrappers should fade from the ambient background into transparency in both light and dark mode.

primary.usage: Active states, floating prompt actions, primary buttons

cursor_card.frame_behavior: Ambient edge fade from parent background to transparent
cursor_card.action_tone: Primary-soft by default for shortlist and search actions
cursor_card.interaction_rule: Decorative frame must never intercept taps

geometry.shadows: None or extremely subtle floating shadows for active composer states

chat_composer.shape: rounded-full (pill) or highly rounded for multi-line

cursor_property_card.wrapper: Ambient fade frame using system light/dark background context
cursor_property_card.content: Swipeable media viewer when multiple images exist, then title, price, location, key facts, one clear CTA
cursor_property_card.flow: Vertical list, no carousel or stacked deck
cursor_property_card.cta: Dedicated footer action with RTL-first alignment
cursor_property_card.media_behavior: Inline swipe inside the card, tap image to open the fullscreen property gallery, and keep image interaction separate from the body press

rules: Assistant text remains more open and typographic than user bubbles.
Structured cards should feel native to the conversation rather than pasted on top of it.
Follow-up prompts should move the user forward, not add decorative choice overload.

chat_input.shape: One calm multiline prompt surface with generous radius
chat_input.idle_actions: At most two visible idle actions, typically mic and send as one dynamic trailing action
chat_input.voice_states: Permission, recording, upload, and transcription states stay inline and explicit
chat_input.behavior: Keep the input visually centered at rest and let it grow only when content requires it
